subject: POC scalability win — quick 15m soundbite and metrics summary
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@finvolve.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC scalability win — quick 15m soundbite and metrics summary

Hi Sandeep,

Thanks again for running the POC with Redwood — really appreciate how fast your team moved. Attaching a short one-page recap but wanted to pull the headline numbers here so marketing can surface them next week and so we can share a short customer soundbite.

Quick metrics recap from the pilot (3-week window, production-like traffic):
- Throughput: sustained 4.1x increase for batch scoring jobs vs your prior baseline
- Per-inference cost: ~60% reduction after batching + quantized model runtime
- Median 95th latency: decreased from ~320ms to ~95ms (95th from 780ms to 210ms)
- Error surface: no functional regressions observed in our evaluation set; accuracy drift <= 0.6%
- Availability during test: 99.95% (2 incident blips resolved by autoscale policy)

If you’re open to it, would you and/or Priya be willing to do one of the following this week?
- A very short 2–3 line quote we can publish (I can draft)
- A 15-minute call for a 1–2 sentence on-record soundbite and permission to cite the metrics above

I can send a one-paragraph draft and a suggested two-sentence blurb to make this fast. We’d only publish with your sign-off.

Attachments: redwood-poc-summary-report.pdf (PDF, 1.4MB), dashboard-snapshot.png (PNG)

Appreciate it — the impact here is material and we want to make this effortless on your side.

—
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
Book a time: https://calendly.com/logan-redwood/15min

Great to see this write-up, thanks. The numbers line up with what we observed on our side; throughput and cost-per-inference were the biggest wins for us. Priya (cc’d) is our CTO and would like to be in the loop.

We can do a 15-minute call — happy to provide a short on-record comment. If you can send a draft 2–3 line blurb, that will make it quicker for us to sign off.

Prefer times after 1pm PT today or tomorrow morning.

Also: can you note in the blurb that the cost figure reflects the combination of batching and quantization so we don’t imply model-level changes?

Thanks,

If that feels good, we’ll use the first sentence as the headline metric and keep the rest for context. Per your ask, I noted the cost reduction is driven by batching + quantization in the second clause.
